name: Entire Foods Market
address: 1 Heirloom Commons, Pasture Ridge Power Center, Building D, Exit 14B
about: Entire Foods Market is a certified whole-adjacent provisioning environment. Every item we carry is food, and every item we do not carry is also food, which is why we do not carry it. Our prices are set in a serif typeface by a committee that meets seasonally.
announcement: SEASONAL NOTICE: The chalkboards are being rewritten this week. Prices shown may be lower than the prices being written.

reviews.name: Dana R.
reviews.text: I asked for no bun and was charged for the bun's absence. The staff explained it to me until I agreed.

reviews.name: Marcus V.
reviews.text: The Warm Bar arrived at Municipal weight class and would not fit through the door frame. Flavor was excellent.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.text: Bought water with a documented aquifer. The aquifer sent a follow-up card. I have not responded.

reviews.name: Terrence O.
reviews.text: The Raw Wheel is raw and it is a wheel. No further claims were made and none were needed.

reviews.name: Sylvie B.
reviews.text: I declined wellness and was billed for the decision, which felt fair on reflection.

menu.name: The Warm Bar (By Weight Class)
menu.blurb: Priced by weight class, not by weight. Weight class is assigned at the counter and is final.

items.name: The Warm Bar Container
items.desc: A compostable clamshell loaded until the hinge surrenders. Contents are seasonal, rotational, and not itemized on any receipt.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a compostable clamshell hot-bar container packed far past its hinge, glossy roasted root vegetables, turmeric-stained cauliflower, wild rice, braised greens and chickpeas heaped into a straining dome that has forced the lid open, sauce sliding down the outer wall onto the table, steam rising in visible ribbons. Shot from directly above and slightly inside the vessel, looking down into the food so the container walls frame every edge. A raw reclaimed-wood market table with woven baskets, burlap and a small blank chalkboard card just out of focus behind. Soft diffuse north daylight through a large window, gentle shadows, matte natural texture, earnest farmers-market styling. 90mm macro, f/4. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Personal
options.note: One adult, standing.

options.name: Structural Thicket

items.name: Cauliflower That Has Been Addressed

options.name: Fully Addressed
options.note: Approximately eleven minutes.

options.name: Left Unaddressed

options.name: Deeply Charred

options.name: Uncharred

options.name: Reservoir

options.name: Very Ancient

options.name: Overloaded

options.name: Entire Bunch, Untrimmed

items.name: The Rotisserie Object
items.desc: Something has been rotating in the window since opening. It is finished now. It is wholesome.

options.note: We will tell you what it is.

options.name: Unidentified
options.note: We will not.

options.name: Identified Later
options.note: Identification arrives separately, by mail.

options.name: Trough Hookup

menu.name: The Single-Origin Aisle
menu.blurb: Every ingredient in this section can name its parents.

items.name: Single-Origin Grain Bowl, Documented
items.desc: Farro, black quinoa, roasted squash and shaved fennel, each with an individual point of origin on file. The file is available for purchase.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: an enormous shallow ceramic bowl of grains built into a leaning tower, farro, black quinoa, roasted squash wedges, shaved fennel, pickled onion, a thick tahini pour cascading over one side and pooling on the wood, microgreens overhanging the rim by several inches, the bowl visibly straining under the load. Three-quarter hero angle, camera slightly above table height, background falling away. A raw reclaimed-wood market table with woven baskets, burlap and a small blank chalkboard card blurred behind. Soft diffuse north daylight through a large window, gentle shadows, matte natural texture, earnest farmers-market styling. 50mm, f/2.8, shallow depth of field. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Extended Dossier
options.note: Includes soil pH and the farmer's stated mood.

options.name: Undocumented
options.note: Undocumented grain requires additional paperwork.

options.name: Sectioned
options.note: Sections are maintained by a divider that is retained by us.

options.name: Amalgamated
options.note: Structure is not guaranteed after transit.

options.name: Whole Sunflower Head
options.note: Sold as-is. De-seeding is not included.

options.name: No Bread
options.note: The toppings are assembled in the shape of bread.

options.name: Neither, Firmly
options.note: A position on fat must still be taken and filed.

options.name: A Whole Avocado, Unopened
options.note: Opening is not included at this tier.

items.name: One Avocado, Fully Traceable
items.desc: A single avocado accompanied by its complete travel history. Ripeness is scheduled, not observed.

options.name: Ready Retroactively
options.note: Was ready. Is no longer. Was, though.

options.name: Pit Removed
options.note: Removal is a labour line item.

options.note: The pit travels in its own bag.

options.name: Volcanic
options.note: Sourced downwind.

items.name: Heritage Legume Assembly
items.desc: Beans with a documented lineage, braised in their own liquor. Assembly refers to the beans, not to furniture.

options.name: Rescued Cultivar
options.note: Rescued from a competitor.

options.name: Anonymous Bean
options.note: Anonymity is preserved at cost.

options.name: Ceremonial
options.note: The ceremony is performed off-site and is not attended.

options.name: Unsoaked
options.note: Unsoaked legumes are billed at the soaked rate for parity.

menu.name: Waters of Record
menu.blurb: All water has a history. Ours has representation.

items.name: Aquifer Water, Vintage Undisclosed
items.desc: Drawn from a single aquifer of record and bottled under seal. Caloric content is disclosed as a precaution.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a grocery store employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a heavy plain smooth amber glass water bottle with a wax-dipped cork top standing upright on a scratched laminate counter, cold condensation running down the completely blank glass, the water inside faintly greenish, a second identical bottle lying on its side behind it, this is the prepared-foods back counter of a natural grocery store with a wooden crate and a stack of paper bags at the edge of frame. Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out hotspot on the curve of the glass, hard black shadow thrown behind the bottle. Framed slightly crooked, the bottle cut off at the top edge, shot from too close. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, noisy, mixed white balance, no filter, no border, no vignette, no rounded corners, image fills the whole frame edge to edge. Square crop. No text, no lettering, no embossed letters, no signage, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Unnamed Aquifer
options.note: The aquifer has declined to be named.

options.name: Aquifer Under Dispute
options.note: Includes a litigation surcharge.

options.name: Returnable, Not Returned
options.note: The deposit is collected. Return is not offered.

options.name: Sediment Visible
options.note: Sediment is part of the story.

items.name: Glacial Runoff, Filed
items.desc: Meltwater collected under permit and filed on arrival. The filing is the product.

options.name: Pre-Industrial
options.note: Predates the concept of a fee, but not this one.

options.name: Undetermined
options.note: Determination is available for purchase separately.

options.name: Cold at Dispatch Only
options.note: Temperature after dispatch is a shared responsibility.

options.name: Violently Carbonated
options.note: Open at a distance.

items.desc: Water raised to a pH of your choosing in a returnable flask. Each tier is achieved by machinery.

options.note: Not recommended with food, or without.

options.name: Deposit Waived
options.note: The waiver is administered at cost.

options.name: Flask Retained by Customer
options.note: You now own a flask. This was your decision.

options.name: Agricultural Grade
options.note: Formulated for fields. Sold to households.

items.name: Municipal Water, Reframed
items.desc: Water from the municipal supply, poured into glass and reframed by our team. The water is unchanged.

options.name: Presented Without Comment
options.note: The silence is prepared by our team.

options.name: Withheld
options.note: Withholding is performed by a licensed professional.

options.name: Whole Fruit, Submerged
options.note: Displacement is expected.

menu.name: Strictly Raw
menu.blurb: The only claim these items make is that they are raw. No further claim is made or implied.

items.name: The Raw Wheel
items.desc: A pressed wheel of cashew, date and cacao that has never been heated. Cut with a warmed wire, which is disclosed.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a grocery store employee to upload to a food delivery app. Empty deserted stockroom, nobody present. Subject: a thick round no-bake cashew and date cake sitting alone on a white paper plate in the middle of a scratched stainless steel counter, one wedge already cut out and leaning beside it, showing dense layers of dark pressed date base, pale cashew filling, a green pistachio seam and a soft dark cacao topping that has sagged over the cut edge, crumbs scattered on the plate, a plastic knife lying on the counter beside the plate. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Shot from high above and too close, looking down at the counter, the plate not centred and cut off at one edge, only the counter surface visible around it. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, noisy, no filter, no border, no vignette. Square crop. No text, no signage, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no fingers, no arms, no bodies, no people.

options.name: Unverified
options.note: The verification is withheld, not the temperature.

options.name: Watershed
options.note: Delivered flat. Assembly is not offered.

items.name: Unheated Sprout Terrine
items.desc: Sprouts pressed into a terrine at ambient temperature. It continues to grow slightly in the bag.

options.name: Day Seven
options.note: Older sprouts have more to say.

options.name: Unbound
options.note: Unbound terrine is delivered as a volume rather than a shape.

options.name: Active Culture, Live
options.note: Continues to develop in transit.

items.name: Raw Bar Slab, Unbaked
items.desc: A dense pressed bar the length of a forearm. It has never met an oven and never will.

options.name: Sweetener Declined
options.note: The dates remain. Only the doctrine changes.

options.name: Load-Bearing
options.note: Rated for shelving. Not rated for shelves.

items.name: Cold-Pressed Root Cylinder

options.name: Press Interrupted
options.note: Interruption occurs on our schedule, not yours.

options.name: Undisclosed Root
options.note: The root is on file with the store.

menu.name: The Compliance Shelf
menu.blurb: Supplements are shelved beside snacks because the distinction is not ours to make.

items.name: Adaptogen Cluster Tray
items.desc: Dozens of bound clusters of seed, mushroom powder and honey on a lined tray. Wellness is applied at the tray level.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a grocery store employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: an aluminium foil tray lined with a sheet of parchment and packed with dozens of dark seed and mushroom powder energy clusters, cocoa-dusted domes and amber honey-bound bars, loose hemp seeds scattered across the parchment, one cluster broken in half, the cardboard lid propped against the side of the tray, this is the prepared-foods back counter of a natural grocery store. Dim warm store light with the flash off, slightly underexposed and noisy. Cluttered background: a stainless prep counter, a napkin dispenser, a stack of lids and a wooden crate waiting behind. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Enhanced Wellness
options.note: Enhancement is monitored.

options.name: Wellness Declined
options.note: Declining wellness is itself a wellness decision and is billed as one.

options.name: No Liner
options.note: The tray is lined conceptually.

options.name: Practitioner-Grade Stack
options.note: Requires a compatible constitution.

items.name: Compliance Gummies, Unflavored
items.desc: A daily obligation in chewable form. Flavour was considered and then formally excluded.

options.name: As Directed
options.note: Direction is provided separately and is not included.

options.name: Flavour Requested
options.note: Requests are recorded. Flavour is not added.

items.name: Protein Brick, Ambient
items.desc: A rectangular protein mass stored at room temperature indefinitely. It does not soften and it does not spoil.

options.name: Cricket
options.note: Regionally legal in this district.

options.name: Undeclared
options.note: Non-declaration is processed at the same rate.

options.name: Masonry Grade
options.note: Not for load-bearing use without consultation.

menu.name: The Bulk Corridor
menu.blurb: Scoop volumes are advisory. Allocation is binding.

items.name: Bulk Bin Allocation, Scooped
items.desc: Your allotment from the corridor bins, bagged and weighed against a chart that is not posted.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a grocery store employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: six brown kraft paper bags folded open and overfilled with bulk goods lined up on the counter, steel-cut oats, black lentils, dried mulberries, cacao nibs, whole almonds and pink salt crystals, grains spilled around the bases of the bags, a plain wooden scoop lying on its side in one bag, this is the bulk aisle counter of a natural grocery store. Bright unflattering daylight through a window on one side, blown highlights on the near edge of the paper bags. The bags sitting directly on a scratched laminate counter with crumbs and spilled seeds beside them. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, noisy, mixed white balance. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Scooped by You, Remotely
options.note: You will be informed of when you scooped.

options.name: Scoop Foregone
options.note: Contents are poured instead. Pouring is a premium service.

options.name: Watershed Draw
options.note: Delivered on a pallet to the curb.

items.name: The Nut Butter Extrusion, Live-Ground
items.desc: Ground in front of you by a machine that has not been switched off since installation. Volume is determined at the nozzle.

options.name: Continuous

options.name: Pre-Ground
options.note: Ground previously, at the same rate.

options.name: Municipal Feed

options.name: Left Separated
options.note: Separation is natural and is billed as a feature.

items.name: Trail Mixture, Unsorted

options.name: Sorted, Then Recombined
options.note: Recombination restores the original state at additional cost.

options.name: Raisin-Dominant
options.note: Raisin dominance is not a discount.
